1. **#1934, "(fix) Framework and E2E test fixes", 2026-10-05** (commit `744dd2ab`). Both added and removed lines. In `packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.test.ts`, the import changed from `getExtensionConfig` to `getExtensionConfigFromStore` (line 13), and three call sites were removed (lines 1317, 1346, 1359).
2. **#1922, "(fix) Minimize churn from config updates when there are many extensions", 2026-09-30** (commit `c1bfbcbb`). Added two lines in `module-config.test.ts` (lines 1317 and 1346).
3. **#1870, "(fix) Ensure slot-specific configuration are correctly passed everywhere", 2026-09-09** (commit `2864290a`). Added five lines in `module-config.test.ts` (lines 1359, 1388, 1416, 1429, 1434).
4. **#1856, "(BREAKING) Extension system should not re-derive in full on every write", 2026-09-02** (commit `9042cb6c`). Both added and removed lines. In `packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts`, line 365 was removed and a call was added at line 498.
